headline: Diamines & Chemicals sends notices for unclaimed dividends over seven years
summary: Diamines & Chemicals Limited has issued notices to shareholders who have failed to claim or encash their dividends for seven consecutive years or more. This procedure is part of regulatory compliance regarding unpaid corporate payouts. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should check their records for any missed dividend payouts to avoid potential transfer of shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF).
why_it_matters: Check old dividends to prevent share transfer to IEPF.
